args.title: Document the limits on report fields in the API reference
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add the documented maximum lengths and maximum numbers for fields in the Reports API, such as max 20 recipients in schedule, max 120 characters for the report name, and max 50 categories, so users can validate input before sending requests.

file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The maximum limits on report fields such as the number of recipients in a schedule, the maximum length of the report name, and the maximum number of categories are implemented in src/api/reports.ts but not documented in the API reference. This pull request will add these limits to the documentation for better client-side validation before sending requests.
